build_distributed_impala_agent: build a DistributedIMPALA agent with environment and network factories for Atari training
test_distributed_agent_atari: test the distributed IMPALA agent runs steps without crashing using a fake Atari environment
run_distributed_agent_program: run the distributed agent program using launchpad with test_mt launch type
create_learner_handle: create a learner handle from the learner node and dereference to get the learner
step_learner: step the learner forward multiple times to execute training iterations
